comment: Real captures from docs/protocols/sources/UT61BCD.log, whose line labels are the reading the meter displayed - so the expected values are ground truth, not derived from this decoder. The dval expectations are the regression test for the unscaled-dval bug (dval was computed before the SI prefix was known).

tests.comment: [UT61BCD.log] 'DC 348.2 mV AUTO BG' - dval must be the SI base value 0.3482, not the displayed 348.2
[UT61BCD.log] 'DC 0.000 V MAN BG' - unprefixed range, dval equals the displayed value
